node: Grid construction, specialty utility services, EPC execution, and skilled labor capacity
summary: Layer 1B expansion for the grid-services/EPC/labor node finds one obvious reference leader and three smaller or less-obvious US-listed candidates with direct exposure to transmission, distribution, substations, interconnection, grid modernization, utility engineering, or field execution. The strongest direct-exposure names in this pass are Quanta Services, MYR Group, Primoris Services, and Willdan Group. The chokepoint logic remains an inference: if utility, data-center, renewable, and industrial load growth outpaces available engineering, permitting, substation, line-worker, testing, and construction capacity, companies with qualified crews, utility relationships, and backlog visibility could become key beneficiaries. This is research support only, not a trading recommendation.
